title: Blocks event envelope 0.1
description: The wrapper every Blocks domain event is delivered in. Assembled by the dispatcher from an outbox row; consumers match on eventType and branch on eventVersion.

eventId.description: Monotonic per deployment. Stable across redeliveries, so consumers can deduplicate.

eventType.description: Dotted name, e.g. `project.created`. Additive: a new type is a MINOR change.

eventVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the payload schema for this eventType, stamped when the event was written -- not when it was delivered.

tenantId.description: Every event belongs to exactly one tenant. There are no cross-tenant events.

occurredAt.description: When the originating transaction committed, not when the event was dispatched.

payload.description: Shape determined by eventType and eventVersion.
